findings.title: Crowd Control still finishes with a standing bystander inside the circle — the revised count filters only the originally selected crowd
findings.observed: A non-selected NPC inside the ring is ignored; the mission can report Path clear.

findings.title: Crowd Control still counts people outside the visible ring — the revised radial test uses a circle but mxRing draws an ellipse with only 45% of its vertical radius
findings.observed: A person 80 units below the centre is counted outside the 47.25-unit visible ring.

findings.title: Standalone game players get neither night lighting nor car radio — the documented HTML copy never received the new render and takeover code
findings.observed: The standalone night draw has no new light pass and taking road cars starts no radio.

findings.title: Drivers cannot mute or change the radio volume in the audio mixer — radio gain is updated only during unpaused campus simulation
findings.observed: Music off, mute and slider changes leave radio audio at its old volume until resume.

findings.title: Players hear the car radio after being removed from the vehicle at day end or entering an interior — the stop fade runs only during active campus updates
findings.observed: After dayEnd removes the driver, radioStep stops and the radio keeps playing.

findings.title: Drivers who take a car before party-track metadata has loaded get no radio for the whole ride — radioOn returns on an empty playlist and never retries after plBoot finishes
findings.observed: Early takeover sees SONGS with no src, so radioOn returns without playing or retrying.

findings.title: Drivers see Radio on but hear silence and lose normal campus music if audio playback is blocked — the radio ignores play() rejection and leaves RADIO.on set
findings.observed: A rejected play() leaves RADIO.on true, shows Radio on and ducks campus music to 15%.

findings.title: Drivers lose the radio after a temporary song load error even when other tracks are available — onerror marks the track bad and shuts the radio off instead of advancing
findings.observed: An audio error calls radioOff; no remaining party track is tried for that car ride.

findings.title: Players driving campus buggies at night get no headlights or tail lights — the lighting pass explicitly excludes buggy vehicles
findings.observed: A driven vehicle with type buggy is omitted from the night beam and tail-light list.

findings.title: Players choosing reduced particles still get every window glow and traffic beam at night — the new lighting loops never check OPT.lowFx
findings.observed: OPT.lowFx does not gate the window or traffic-light loops.

findings.title: Impostor players still cannot locate the final meeting on the full map — the new active-mission marker loop uses points() which never includes the Main Hall
findings.observed: After tasks and clues, the map shows teammates but no Main Hall meeting marker.

findings.title: Landscape phone drivers can lose sight of the mission timer when taking a road car — the three stacked takeover and radio toasts overlap the timer
findings.observed: Three takeover toasts occupy the same vertical band as the landscape mission timer.

findings.title: A brief car-radio load failure removes that song from The Terrace playlist too — the radio permanently marks the shared SONGS entry bad
findings.observed: Radio errors set the shared party song bad until reload, even after connectivity returns.

findings.title: Crowd Control players cannot politely clear a person who wanders back into the ring — the revised count includes them but the E interaction rejects their cleared crowd role
findings.observed: A previously asked NPC can re-enter and count, but E no longer asks them to move.

findings_minor.title: Phone drivers cannot read the complete radio track announcement — the toast forces long song and artist names onto one truncated line
findings_minor.observed: Long radio song and artist names are ellipsized on narrow phone screens.

findings_minor.title: Players who immediately exit a car still see Radio on after it stops — radioOff never removes the queued radio toast
findings_minor.observed: The Radio on toast remains visible for up to 2.7 seconds after radioOff.

findings_minor.title: Yulu players can receive 3★ just after the displayed par — the finish rounds elapsed time to hundredths before comparing it with the exact threshold
findings_minor.observed: Yulu 62.004s rounds to 62.00s and gets 3★ against the 1:02 par.

findings_minor.title: Drivers can hear an unrelated uploaded audio file on the car radio — its selector uses every custom playlist entry instead of the four party tracks
findings_minor.observed: A custom extra loaded into SONGS can be selected by the radio instead of the four tracks.
